q: Which scope covers ETP sludge a Vapi dye unit sends to a cement kiln?
title: Vapi dye units: sludge sent to kilns
short: Waste you send off site, including sludge sent for co-processing in a cement kiln, is Scope 3 category 5. The kiln's combustion emissions are the cement plant's Scope 1, not yours. Record tonnes sent and the receiver for each load.
audience: Dye and chemical units in the Vapi and Ankleshwar estates sending ETP sludge for co-processing

p: Tonnes of sludge per load, from the manifest.
The receiving facility and the treatment route.
The trucking to the kiln is also Scope 3 if you pay for it.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
